name: Infinite Power reduces damaging spell cooldowns on cast (#5026)
contract: Infinite Power 92118 reads "Casting damaging spells now reduces your damaging spell cooldowns by
$528312s1% of their remaining cooldown". Its effect 0 is aura 42 (SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL)
triggering 503946, whose three effects are the custom effect 192 (EffectMiscValue 801291/801292/806335,
EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10%). Spell.dbc gives 92118 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed,
so it never fired; separately, effect 192 is EffectNULL core-wide, but the already-registered
spell_ascension_the_bieko_effect SpellScript implements it once attached via spell_script_names. The fix
adds both rows. Timerend 801291 (CategoryRecoveryTime 20000 ms) is one of 503946's named targets. Elapsed
time is removed from the measurement by an otherwise identical control Chronomancer who starts the same
Timerend cooldown at the same moment but never learns Infinite Power: both cooldowns decay in real time,
so the difference between them isolates the talent's contribution. Only the talented caster then casts
Wand of Time 520175 (a second damaging spell, unrelated to Timerend) to trigger the proc against
Timerend's already-running cooldown, so the trigger and the affected cooldown are cleanly separated in
time. 92118's own spell_proc row requires SpellPhaseMask PROC_SPELL_PHASE_HIT (2) and SpellTypeMask
PROC_SPELL_TYPE_DAMAGE (1): Spell::cast's unconditional pre-hit proc always fires PROC_SPELL_PHASE_CAST,
so only a spell whose Spell::DoAllEffectOnTarget hit phase classifies as an actual damage hit can satisfy
the row. Reverse Wound 501805 (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL) and Unmake 804418
(TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY, but only SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA/SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY, no direct damage) both
fail SpellTypeMask; Wand of Time carries SPELL_EFFECT_NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG + SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE
(DmgClass 3 = ranged, matching the PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_RANGED_DMG_CLASS bit the fix's own SQL comment
adds for wand attacks) and is the only Chronomancer-accessible direct-damage spell of the three. Fails
before the fix (near-zero difference, only cast-timing skew); passes after (roughly a
10%-of-remaining-at-proc-time reduction, well beyond skew).
